name: android_clipboard
description: Reads the device clipboard, or replaces it when text is given. Needs the `cmd clipboard` shell command, which many devices lack (the Android 10 and 13 devices tested): then it returns an error saying so.

text.description: New clipboard text; omit to read it.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
